item.title: ROTC students subdued and killed Old Dominion University gunman, officials say
item.summary: The school shooting was allegedly committed by a former Army National Guardsman who was convicted of giving material support to ISIS, an FBI official told ABC News.

item.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine awaits White House sign-off on US drone production deal
item.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says he is awaiting White House approval for a major drone production agreement proposed by Kyiv last year

item.title: WATCH: ISIS-inspired teens considered other targets before Gracie Mansion protest
item.summary: The two PA teens charged with attempting what authorities described as an ISIS-inspired attack in New York considered other targets before driving into Manhattan with homemade bombs, sources said.

item.title: Synagogue ramming probed as targeted act of violence against Jewish community: FBI
item.summary: A suspect is dead after a shooting and vehicle ramming incident at a synagogue in West Bloomfield, Michigan, law enforcement sources told ABC News.

item.title: LIVE: ABC News Live
item.summary: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

item.title: WATCH: How active shooter training helped thwart Michigan synagogue attack
item.summary: Retired FBI agent Brad Garrett discusses how an active shooter training in January helped prepare the West Bloomfield, Michigan, synagogue on how to respond to Thursday's vehicle ramming incident.

item.title: WATCH: Sneak-peak at the performances at the Oscars
item.summary: "GMA's" Lara Spencer spoke with Mandy Moore, an Emmy award-winning choreographer, for a preview of the big performances at the Oscars.

item.title: WATCH: No deal in Homeland Security shutdown talks
item.summary: Travelers looking to escape for spring break are encountering long security lines and more widespread travel problems as the latest partial government shutdown drags on.

item.title: WATCH: Pickup truck narrowly avoids children boarding school bus
item.summary: Authorities in Maryland are asking for the public's help identifying the driver of a pickup truck seen in video narrowly missing children getting onto a school bus in Cecil County, Maryland.

item.title: WATCH: Meteorite fragment crashes through roof of house in Germany
item.summary: A meteorite was spotted this past weekend over several European countries. It eventually broke into pieces, with one fragment smashing through the roof of a house in Germany.
